t: This is St Giles' Church, the parish church of Camberwell. It's dedicated to Saint Giles, patron saint of disabled people, and a local legend links that to a well near Camberwell Grove, which may even have given the district its name. The church was designed by Sir George Gilbert Scott, the prolific Gothic Revival architect, together with William Bonython Moffatt, his long-time partner. Buried here is Sir Henry Mainwaring, a lawyer, seaman and for a time a pirate, who later served as a naval officer, along with his wife Fortune Gardiner.
